legal_version: Council Directive 91/263/EEC of 29 April 1991; OJ L 128, 23.05.1991
exact_legal_excerpt: Member States shall notify to the Commission the bodies established in the Community and their identifying symbols, which they have designated for carrying out the certification, product checks, and associated surveillance tasks pertaining to the procedures referred to in Article 9.
institutional_statement: Notification of designated bodies and identifying symbols
explicit_condition: Bodies established in the Community and designated for the specified tasks
segmentation_rationale: Single operative notification clause; designation is retained as a textual condition rather than inferred as a separate relation

legal_version: Council Directive 91/263/EEC of 29 April 1991; OJ L 128, 23.05.1991
exact_legal_excerpt: Member States shall inform the Commission of test laboratories established in the Community which they have designated for carrying out tests pertaining to the procedures referred to in Article 9.
institutional_statement: Information to the Commission concerning designated test laboratories
explicit_condition: Laboratories established in the Community and designated for Article 9 procedure tests
segmentation_rationale: One operative informing clause; no independent designation relationship is attributed

legal_version: Council Directive 91/263/EEC of 29 April 1991; OJ L 128, 23.05.1991
exact_legal_excerpt: The notified body shall assess the quality system to determine whether it satisfies the requirements referred to in point 3.2.
explicit_condition: To determine whether the system satisfies point 3.2 requirements
segmentation_rationale: Assessment is separated from later notification because the latter has a distinct action and recipient

legal_version: Council Directive 91/263/EEC of 29 April 1991; OJ L 128, 23.05.1991
exact_legal_excerpt: The decision shall be notified to the manufacturer. The notification shall contain the conclusions of the examination and the reasoned assessment decision.
institutional_statement: Notification of the decision and stated contents
explicit_condition: Notification contains examination conclusions and reasoned assessment decision
segmentation_rationale: Passive construction does not expressly identify the notifying actor; no actor is supplied by inference

legal_version: Council Directive 91/263/EEC of 29 April 1991; OJ L 128, 23.05.1991
exact_legal_excerpt: The notified body shall carry out audits at reasonable intervals to make sure that the manufacturer maintains and applies the quality system
institutional_statement: Periodic audit of maintenance and application of the quality system
object_or_recipient: manufacturer's maintenance and application of the quality system
explicit_condition: At reasonable intervals; to make sure the manufacturer maintains and applies the system
segmentation_rationale: Audit and reporting are distinct operative actions in the same provision and are kept separate

legal_version: Council Directive 91/263/EEC of 29 April 1991; OJ L 128, 23.05.1991
exact_legal_excerpt: The notified body shall carry out audits at reasonable intervals to make sure that the manufacturer maintains and applies the quality system and shall provide an audit report to the manufacturer.
explicit_condition: Following the required audit activity in the same sentence
segmentation_rationale: Coordinated second action is registered separately to preserve its explicit recipient

legal_version: Commission Regulation (EC) No 874/2004 of 28 April 2004; OJ L 162, 30.04.2004
exact_legal_excerpt: At the end of the phased registration an independent audit shall be performed at the expense of the Registry and shall report its findings to the Commission.
explicit_condition: At the end of the phased registration; audit at Registry expense
segmentation_rationale: The text grammatically makes the audit report; no natural-person actor is inserted

legal_version: Commission Regulation (EC) No 874/2004 of 28 April 2004; OJ L 162, 30.04.2004
exact_legal_excerpt: The auditor shall be appointed by the Registry after consulting the Commission.
explicit_condition: After consulting the Commission
segmentation_rationale: Passive legal construction is represented with its express appointing institution; consultation is not expanded into a relationship conclusion

legal_version: Commission Regulation (EC) No 874/2004 of 28 April 2004; OJ L 162, 30.04.2004
exact_legal_excerpt: The Registry shall select the validation agents in an objective, transparent and non-discriminatory manner, ensuring the widest possible geographical diversity.
explicit_condition: Objectively, transparently and non-discriminatorily; ensuring widest possible geographical diversity
segmentation_rationale: Selection is one operative clause; attributes remain conditions rather than coded conclusions

legal_version: Commission Regulation (EC) No 874/2004 of 28 April 2004; OJ L 162, 30.04.2004
exact_legal_excerpt: The Registry shall require the validation agent to execute the validation in an objective, transparent and non-discriminatory manner.
explicit_condition: Objectively, transparently and non-discriminatorily
segmentation_rationale: A separate operative requirement follows the selection clause and is not merged with it

legal_version: Commission Regulation (EC) No 874/2004 of 28 April 2004; OJ L 162, 30.04.2004
exact_legal_excerpt: Every applicant shall submit documentary evidence that shows that he or she is the holder of the prior right claimed on the name in question. The documentary evidence shall be submitted to a validation agent indicated by the Registry.
object_or_recipient: documentary evidence to a validation agent indicated by the Registry
explicit_condition: Evidence shows the applicant holds the claimed prior right
segmentation_rationale: The applicant's submission is kept distinct from the Registry's indication of an agent; no designation relationship is inferred

legal_version: Commission Regulation (EC) No 874/2004 of 28 April 2004; OJ L 162, 30.04.2004
exact_legal_excerpt: The relevant validation agent shall examine whether the applicant that is first in line to be assessed for a domain name and that has submitted the documentary evidence before the deadline has prior rights on the name.
institutional_statement: Examination of the first-in-line applicant's prior rights
object_or_recipient: whether the applicant has prior rights on the name
explicit_condition: Applicant is first in line and submitted documentary evidence before the deadline
segmentation_rationale: Examination is a discrete action; the statement does not decide whether rights exist

legal_version: Commission Regulation (EC) No 874/2004 of 28 April 2004; OJ L 162, 30.04.2004
exact_legal_excerpt: If the documentary evidence has not been received in time or if the validation agent finds that the documentary evidence does not substantiate a prior right, he shall notify the Registry of this.
institutional_statement: Notification of late or insufficient evidence
explicit_condition: Evidence not received in time OR agent finds it does not substantiate a prior right
segmentation_rationale: Conditional notification is distinct from assessment and preserves the textual alternatives

legal_version: Commission Regulation (EC) No 874/2004 of 28 April 2004; OJ L 162, 30.04.2004
exact_legal_excerpt: If the validation agent finds that prior rights exist regarding the application for a particular domain name that is first in line, he shall notify the Registry accordingly.
explicit_condition: Agent finds prior rights regarding a first-in-line application
segmentation_rationale: Positive and negative notification conditions are separately observable and must not be collapsed

legal_version: Commission Regulation (EC) No 874/2004 of 28 April 2004; OJ L 162, 30.04.2004
exact_legal_excerpt: The Registry shall, at its own expense, enter into an agreement with a reputable trustee or other escrow agent established within the territory of the Community designating the Commission as the beneficiary of the escrow agreement.
object_or_recipient: reputable trustee or other escrow agent
explicit_condition: At Registry expense; escrow agent established in Community; agreement designates Commission as beneficiary
segmentation_rationale: Agreement and later data submission are distinct actions; beneficiary designation is retained as a textual condition

legal_version: Commission Regulation (EC) No 874/2004 of 28 April 2004; OJ L 162, 30.04.2004
exact_legal_excerpt: The Commission shall give its consent to that agreement before it is concluded.
explicit_condition: Before the agreement is concluded
segmentation_rationale: The consent clause is separately recorded without inferring approval architecture or legal effect beyond the text

legal_version: Commission Regulation (EC) No 874/2004 of 28 April 2004; OJ L 162, 30.04.2004
exact_legal_excerpt: The Registry shall submit to the escrow agent on a daily basis an electronic copy of the current content of the .eu database.
institutional_statement: Daily submission of a database copy
object_or_recipient: electronic copy of current .eu database content to escrow agent
explicit_condition: On a daily basis
segmentation_rationale: The data-submission action has an explicit recipient and is separate from agreement formation

legal_version: Commission Regulation (EC) No 874/2004 of 28 April 2004; OJ L 162, 30.04.2004
exact_legal_excerpt: The complaints and the responses to those complaints must be submitted to an ADR provider chosen by the complainant from the list referred to in the first paragraph of Article 23.
institutional_statement: Submission of complaints and responses to an ADR provider
object_or_recipient: complaints and responses to an ADR provider
explicit_condition: Provider chosen by complainant from Article 23(1) list
segmentation_rationale: Passive formulation does not expressly state the submitter; no party is inferred

legal_version: Commission Regulation (EC) No 874/2004 of 28 April 2004; OJ L 162, 30.04.2004
exact_legal_excerpt: As soon as a request for ADR is properly filed with the ADR provider and the appropriate fee is paid, the ADR provider shall inform the Registry of the identity of the complainant and the domain name involved.
institutional_statement: Information to the Registry following filing of ADR request
object_or_recipient: Registry of complainant identity and domain name
explicit_condition: ADR request properly filed and appropriate fee paid
segmentation_rationale: The operative information clause is frozen separately; Article 22(7) is excluded as contextual audit evidence

legal_version: Commission Regulation (EC) No 874/2004 of 28 April 2004; OJ L 162, 30.04.2004
exact_legal_excerpt: The Registry may select ADR providers, who shall be reputable bodies with appropriate expertise in an objective, transparent and non-discriminatory manner.
explicit_condition: Providers are reputable bodies with appropriate expertise; selection objective, transparent and non-discriminatory
segmentation_rationale: Modal permission is preserved as may; provider qualifications are retained as conditions
